decisions.reason: The 15-day express option has only been mentioned and overlaps with the broader express line, so its limited option value no longer justifies keeping it open.
The fire-resistant exterior door is featured and has European approval, indicating realized value and leaving little uncertainty to justify withdrawal.
The express delivery line with several models and its own page still holds option value as demand uncertainty resolves, so it is worth keeping.
The online platform is a strategic digital option whose upside and uncertainty justify continuing to keep it open.
The fire and smoke protection door is only mentioned and overlaps with the featured fire-resistant door, so its marginal option value is low and it should be abandoned.
